fact: A workshop on 24 October 2024 validated Mali's national digital economy development policy (PNDEN) and its action plan for 2025-2029, correcting a previous plan (2015-2020) that reached only a 27.30% execution rate with 24.24% of resources mobilised.
title: Avenir numérique du Mali : La Politique nationale de développement de l'économie numérique validée
